## Problem

What are you trying to do that the tool doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other approaches you've thought about.

## Scope check

This tool is deliberately small, dependency-free, and Windows/PowerShell 7
focused. Does your request fit that scope? If it adds a runtime dependency,
please explain why it's worth it.
